title: claim.notice
description:
A claim exists. Broadcast on the colony's claims channel, which is a second topic beside the colony channel: everybody in a colony needs to know a claim was filed, and almost nobody needs the whole of it.

Small on purpose. A node reads the notice, decides from the title and description whether this is work it wants to look at, and fetches the claim itself point-to-point if it is.

title.description: What this claims, in one line. Not on chain: the chain holds nothing readable, and the reader this serves is reading the bus.

evidenceComplete.description: False says the claim is filed but its evidence is still arriving, so a validator that starts now will be judging an incomplete submission. Priority was fixed when the claim was recorded, so there is no advantage in filing early and completing late — only a validator's wasted afternoon, which this exists to prevent.
